blind.description: An antique slant-front writing bureau or secretary desk. The lower section features three horizontal drawers with ornate brass bail handles, raised on low bracket feet. The upper portion has a sloping fall-front lid inlaid with an oval wood medallion and a brass escutcheon, topped by a small flat surface enclosed by a miniature brass gallery railing. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and fully detailed with dark reddish-brown polished wood textures and brass hardware.
blind.from_above: A neat rectangular footprint showing the narrow flat top bounded by a three-sided brass railing, sloping down to the angled front writing flap with an oval inlay, with the fronts of drawer pulls slightly visible below.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.3 feet tall (roughly half to 60% of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 feet wide.
